scope: Local implementation of slice S1 of docs/QR_4_QUALIFIED_SELECTION_CONTRACT.md for PM-1 row F10-03: a pure ranking and eligibility module (src/selection/) with registration, eligibility checks E1 to E6, the common-window rules and the RO-12 recheck as pure functions, the objective qr4-objective-lexi-v1 and filters, ranking with ties and outcomes, transitions, overlays, replay, labels and route guards. It is pure, not wired into any route, table or worker, and shows the owner nothing.
method: A coder wrote the module from the contract; an independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) reviewed it twice; an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran single-edit mutations after each review. Root ruled on every finding and recorded the contract clarifications RC-S1 to RC-S17. One value is the owner's: the two tie tolerances (OD-S3), which stay unset, so every registration is refused until the owner sets them. Nobody verified their own work.

limits: Pure module only: tables, the evaluation job, the API and the view do not exist yet.
The tie tolerances are unset until the owner decides OD-S3.
The development-view parameter and evaluation-request key allow-lists are root choices that the contract does not list.
Whether a fixture selection writes an exposure record or counts toward prior selections is open for a later slice.
The coder wrote the tests; an independent section 16 test pass is still needed before acceptance of the row.
No staging readback and no PostgreSQL run.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings and the final diff and accepted the slice as local engineering evidence for F10-03. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and grants no ranking or label to the owner.
